description: Validate a data transformation pipeline. Examine process_orders.py which transforms CSV order data to JSON. Create a test CSV file named 'orders.csv' with at least 3 orders (format: OrderID,CustomerName,OrderDate,Items,TotalAmount where Items is 'Name:$Price,Name:$Price'). Include at least one edge case. Run the script with 'python process_orders.py' to generate report.json. Inspect the output for correctness. Add validation logic (assertions, logging, or debugging prints) to the code. Document your findings in a file named 'VALIDATION.md' explaining what you tested and any issues found.
